name: task-2
_ambiguities: Config panel hidden in preview is NOT asserted: the replay runner has no negative-visibility op, and hiding may be display:none or DOM removal.

The preview steps set localStorage.data by hand (task-4 format, constructor-param keys) and depend on the preview page rendering saved questions (task-5 behaviour). They can only pass once preview renders questions.
contenteditable is asserted only after clicking the title; whether it is set before any click is not pinned.
Random titles are not asserted; which question .q-remove removes is not pinned (only the count).
Whether the title becomes editable via click alone (no double click) is assumed from the spec wording "clicked to edit".
